stages.name: Credential and Wallet Harvesting
observables: Reading plaintext seed phrases for cryptocurrency wallets from disk
Harvesting session tokens and browser credentials

stages.name: AI-Assisted Email Enrichment
observables: Using stolen session tokens to search victim emails for purchase receipts
Extracting physical home addresses from email content

stages.name: LLM-Based Data Prioritization
observables: Sending structured evidence bundles to LLM APIs for ranking
Multi-model failover to different AI providers if primary assessment is refused
Exfiltration of a prioritized dossier of high-value assets

stages.name: Malware Self-Deletion
observables: Malware executable deleting itself from the filesystem after exfiltration

scenario.summary: VOLTA is a mature Windows infostealer that automates victim profiling by using LLMs to prioritize stolen data. The malware harvests credentials and cryptocurrency wallets before using stolen session access to search the victim's emails for physical addresses to enrich the data, finally exfiltrating a prioritized dossier and self-deleting.

meta.rationale: Begin by focusing on hosts where developer tools or high-value crypto-related software is expected. Widen the hunt if DNS activity to LLM domains is observed on unrelated systems.
meta.hypothesis: An intruder has deployed an infostealer that uses headless browser sessions to harvest credentials and cryptocurrency wallets, followed by exfiltration to LLM providers for AI-driven data prioritization and automated cleanup via self-deletion.

hunt.name: AI-Enhanced Infostealer Lifecycle
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the mature VOLTA infostealer lifecycle by correlating behavioral endpoint indicators with network-based data prioritization patterns. It begins by scoping hosts with browser installations, then parallelizes the search for headless browser execution and sensitive file access (wallets/cookies). An agent triages these early-stage results before the hunt pivots to observe exfiltration to LLM API endpoints and malware self-deletion. This phased approach allows for the detection of automated, AI-assisted theft that baseline detection rules often miss due to the modular nature of the attack.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%chrome%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%chromium%'
config.description: Identify hosts in the estate that have Chrome or Chromium installed, focusing the hunt on platforms capable of supporting VOLTA's headless browser harvesting.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts where browser software is present. Silence means no hosts match, which restricts the hunt only to those systems.

primitive_config.label: Scope hosts with browser installations
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%chrome%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%chromium%'
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts where browser software is present. Silence means no hosts match, which restricts the hunt only to those systems.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, parent_process_name, parent_process_cmd_line, process_cmd_line, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%--headless%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify processes launching Chrome with the --headless flag and stack-count the parents to find rare, suspicious binaries.
config.expected_signal: Rare parent processes launching headless Chrome. Legitimate automation (CI/CD, Selenium) will cluster together, while infostealer binaries will stand out.

primitive_config.label: Headless browser launch analysis
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, parent_process_name, parent_process_cmd_line, process_cmd_line, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%--headless%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Rare parent processes launching headless Chrome. Legitimate automation (CI/CD, Selenium) will cluster together, while infostealer binaries will stand out.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, file_path, file_name, activity_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{sensitive_filenames}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\google\chrome\user data%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find file activity where suspicious processes access cryptocurrency seeds or browser credential files.
